[[File:Kendall Halman 2020 Content Creator Award.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Kendall Halman with his 2020 Content Creator Award.]]
'''Kendall Halman''' (GEMP handle '''corran''')<ref name="roster">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81218 SWCCG Teams - Rosters], Joe Olson (21 July 2022; spreadsheet updated 14 September 2025). [[:File:SWCCG Teams Rosters 14 September 2025.txt]]; [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit Google Sheet]; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008235350/https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing 8 October 2026]</ref> finished '''#18''' at the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]]. He also finished '''#46''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]]. <ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026/ 2026-09 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)], starwarsccg.org (published 10 September 2026). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/2026_Retro_GEMPC_starwarsccg_org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref> He hosts [[Corran on the Horn]] on the KendallCast Network.<ref name="coth-ep1">[https://www.kendallcast.ninja/2022/01/corran-on-horn-1-james-martin.html Corran on the Horn - 1 - James Martin], KendallCast (24 January 2022). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/corran-on-the-horn-1-james-martin Internet Archive].</ref>
